source.name: Ebonclaw
source.heading: Ch. 8, Faunel, Razortooth Rock
source.pageWitnessNote: The page images are a digital-layout cross-check. Printed foliation and printing were verified in the first-print layout.
source.appearanceEvidence: The adventure calls for a saber-toothed tiger and gives no distinct coat, body, or accessories. The reused portrait shows that animal, including the heavy build, shortened tail and long upper teeth.
ruleComparison: The adventure changes alignment, Intelligence and Charisma to 12, and speech to Common. The indexed summary instead carries the base tiger’s Intelligence 3 and Charisma 8. The 2014 Monster Manual supplies the other combat numbers.

source.name: Ophelia
source.heading: Ch. 8, Faunel, Heart Delta
source.pageWitnessNote: The page images are a digital-layout cross-check. Printed foliation and printing were verified in the first-print layout.
source.appearanceEvidence: The text calls Ophelia an elephant and gives no differing visible traits. The reused gray elephant portrait suits this encounter.
ruleComparison: The adventure changes alignment, Intelligence to 10, Wisdom and Charisma to 14, and speech to Common. Its prose does not restate passive Perception. The displayed 12 follows the new Wisdom modifier with no Perception proficiency. The base elephant has passive Perception 10.

The 2023 adventure inherits the 2014-rules Elephant. The November 2018 Monster Manual errata supplies the +6 damage bonus already in force when the adventure appeared. The first 2014 printing used +5 for both.

source.pageWitnessNote: The page images are a digital-layout cross-check. Printed foliation and printing were verified in the first-print layout.

source.name: Pandarian Dragon Turtle
source.section: Chapter 3, Professions and Gear, Mounts and Vehicles
source.sourceWitness: Readable full capture of the Wizards of the Coast digital stat block published in a review of the expansion’s mounts.
sourceNotes: The digital block shows initiative +1 (11), proficiency bonus +2 and six saving-throw modifiers. Each saving throw equals its printed ability modifier.
The attack applies the Grappled condition to creatures of Large size or smaller. The escape DC is 13.

The publisher’s contents page links to the exact Chapter 3 block. The public image shows the publisher’s complete digital rules and carries no folio. The 5e.tools data supplies p. 104 as a secondary locator.
source.appearanceEvidence: The block identifies a Large dragon turtle and the mount article identifies its use. The available rules capture supplies no physical description. The existing portrait illustrates the named form.
source.habitatEvidence: The available stat block supplies no habitat line.
source.artworkNote: Reused the indexed square parchment portrait for this exact creature. I checked the 1254-by-1254 image and confirmed its SHA-256.
